question:
Study the given graph and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/767ab1f816766de01b304da7630ff747a6420c3978da268072193afa3133b40e.png] 

If 35% of the lecturers recruited in state B in the year 2021 were male, what was the number of females in state B in that year?
solution:
Calculation:

Number of lecturers recruited in state B in 2021 = 5500

Number of male lecturers among them = 5500 × 35% = 1925

Now, the number of female lecturers among them = 5500 - 1925 = 3575

**∴ The number of female lecturers of state B in that year was 3575.**
